title: Northstar SaaS operating structure
goal: Show functional leadership, delivery teams, and a product matrix report.

rubric.must: Maya Ortiz is visibly the CEO at the top of the hierarchy.
Engineering, Product, and Revenue VPs visibly report to the CEO.
Platform, product-engineering, sales, and customer-success teams are visibly nested beneath their functional leaders.
A clearly dashed line labelled Product leadership connects the product VP and group product manager.
Names, titles, and departments remain readable without collisions.
